lean.include_command: data_include <id>  (defined in fv/kraken/lean/Fk/Include.lean; reads ../link/out/data/<id>.data relative to fv/kraken/lean)
lean.bytes_decl: Fk.Data.<id> : List UInt8  (items with `word` entries depend on [Host]: Fk.Data.<id> [Host] : List UInt8)
lean.premise_shape: Theorem premises keep the shape `Eq (bytes.At addr)`. Only `bytes` and `addr` come from Fk.Data. Kraken data memory is separate from code (con-agua DESIGN `ldc`).
lean.word_term: a `word <s> <o>` line is the 8 bytes Int.toBytes 8 (label "<s>" + <o>).toBitVec.toInt (no `+ 0` for o = 0)
lean.aliases: namespace Fk exports the rodata items, their _addr, intType_addr, uint64Type_addr (export aliases, no new constants), so theorems write blFmtB / blFmtB_addr

data_files.format: text, one directive per line; '#' starts a comment line. First directive `at <label> <off>` (label = conv.py-cleaned symbol name, off decimal). Then any number of `bytes <hh> <hh> ...` (two-digit lowercase hex, space separated) and `word <label> <off>` (8-byte little-endian absolute address of label+off, a relocated pointer word). An address-only item has only `at`.
data_files.extractor: fv/kraken/link/data.py (item table inside: id, label, offset, length); writes the files from the ELF and nm
data_files.check: fv/kraken/link/check.py compares every data file with the ELF: bytes = file bytes of the range, word = 8-byte value at that position = symbol address + off; file sha256 in the RESULT bundle
data_files.lake_tracking: lean/lakefile.toml: [[input_dir]] fk_norm_S (../link/out/norm), fk_data (../link/out/data), fk_lean_S (Fk, filter {extension = ["S"]}); Fk lean_lib needs = ["fk_norm_S", "fk_data", "fk_lean_S"]. Experiment: fix3 commit 49c6627 (X1), data-file mutation in b6c32c3 body.
data_files.word_label_rule: the nearest symbol at or below the pointer value; among several there, a label used by the converted code (all.S), then a sized symbol containing it, then the first clean name
data_files.comment_lines: `# <id>: ...` header and, for go:string.* items, `# text '<decoded>'`; comments are ignored by Lean and check.py
